entities.summary: Tony Lee Bradley Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Noblesville Boom of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the University of North Carolina (UNC). A 6'10 center, Bradley was a primary substitute for the Tar Heels' 2017 NCAA championship team.
